responsibility_name: ensure children stop devices and sleep on time

coding.rationale: 11pm device-use and bedtime reminders target children stopping devices and sleeping on time.

responsibility_name: Ensure infant is soothed back to sleep during night crying

coding.rationale: Night crying triggers slow crib movement to restore the infant's sleep.
If medication is not taken in the 08:00-09:00 window, escalating notifications prompt adherence.

responsibility_name: Keep children away from open windows

coding.rationale: A child approaching an open window triggers closing it, guarding against fall harm.

responsibility_name: keep the newborn's room at safe temperature

coding.rationale: Day/night temperature below safe thresholds in the newborn's room triggers adjustment to maintain thermal safety.
Detected baby crying triggers cradle toy and tune to soothe the baby.
When the bowl is not full, feeding activates at user-selected times to keep the pet fed.
When the older adult sits on the stairlift, it activates to move them up or down stairs safely.
Low water intake with prolonged activity triggers reminders to drink and avoid dehydration.
A reminder with missing steps is sent when the daily step goal is unmet.

responsibility_name: maintain healthy indoor air quality and address mould

coding.rationale: High humidity with mould triggers hourly purification and technician contact to guard indoor air health.

responsibility_name: obtain timely treatment and medication when ill

coding.rationale: Elevated body temperature while unwell triggers doctor contact and pharmacy delivery for timely treatment.
When the caregiver is absent and the infant moves beyond the crib bars, the anti-fall net and alert guard the infant.
High room volume with baby presence triggers cradle movement and camera activation to soothe and monitor.

responsibility_name: Support fitness when measured health falls below threshold

coding.rationale: A below-threshold health measurement leads to scheduling a special workout to support fitness.
Study evidence explicitly describes medication reminders supporting resident adherence.
Periodic reminders described as helpful for cognitive training support ongoing resident training.
